_readme: Single source of truth for all cases. Every value has a status: CONFIRMED (agreed with TF), PENDING (placeholder, must be confirmed), or DERIVED (computed from other entries). SI units throughout. Edit here, then re-run scripts/make_cases.py.

material.note: Pure Al from Farzadi et al. (2008) Table 1 - the only paper with a complete constant-property set (k, cp, mu, Lf, dSigma/dT, beta). Swap for Al-1.5Fe (Pariona 2018) if the TF wants that alloy.

length_x.note: Multiple of 0.6 mm so 200/150/100 um all give integer cell counts.

half_width_y.note: 10 mm full width, symmetry plane y=0 on the track centreline.

depth_z.note: Top surface z=0, bottom z=-8 mm.

roi_y.note: Half of the ~5 mm ROI width, rounded to a 0.6 mm multiple.

roi_z.note: ROI depth (5 mm rounded down to a 0.6 mm multiple).

outer_cell.note: Target cell size at the far boundaries outside the ROI (graded).

power.note: Nominal 2 kW Yb-fibre laser (Pariona 2018). Actual power not stated in that paper.

absorptivity.note: Placeholder. Real Al at 1.06 um is ~0.05-0.15; at that level the pool is far below 1 mm (see scripts/estimate_pool.py).

radius.note: D4sigma (1/e^2) radius; 600 um beam diameter from Pariona 2018.

depth.note: Volumetric penetration depth of the superGaussian source; ~surface heating.

k.note: k=2 makes the superGaussian a plain Gaussian.

speed.note: 20 mm/s (lowest Pariona speed, strongest Marangoni effect).

cooling_time.note: Laser-off time simulated after the track to capture solidification/cooling.

h_bottom.note: Workpiece-workbench coefficient h_d in Pariona Eq. 8; no radiation at bottom.

A_mush.note: Read from the TF notes as 'Aroush ~ 1e8': almost certainly the Carman-Kozeny mushy-zone constant C (kg/m3/s) of Farzadi Eq. 2.

B.note: Small constant avoiding division by zero in C(1-fL)^2/(fL^3+B). AdditiveFOAM caps solid fraction at 0.95 instead, so B is not used unless we modify UEqn.H.

DAS.note: AdditiveFOAM uses D = nu*180/DAS^2 * fs^2/(1-fs)^3, so DAS = sqrt(180*mu/A_mush) (~50 um for Al).
